subject.title: ci(qa): reuse Matrix live workflow for releases

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103589 lands and required checks are green, must this PR demonstrate one real release-style reusable Matrix invocation before merge, or are its Testbox contract and workflow-validator results sufficient?
rationale: The implementation centralizes release-critical automation and appears correct statically, but only a release/CI owner can accept contract-only proof for the hosted reusable-workflow, environment, artifact, and status boundary.

options.title: Require one reusable dispatch
options.body: Run the release caller against the reviewed exact SHA and verify successful Matrix execution, standard artifacts, and propagated status before merge.

options.title: Accept contract proof
options.body: Merge after the prerequisite lands and required checks are green, accepting the focused Testbox tests and workflow validators as sufficient evidence.

recommendation.title: Require one reusable dispatch
recommendation.body: Run the release caller against the reviewed exact SHA and verify successful Matrix execution, standard artifacts, and propagated status before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the coordinated Matrix QA workflow stack and have the strongest evidence-backed context for its release proof and sequencing.
